Home Improvement
Home Improvement
The Alpena County Home Improvement Program provides home repair assistance county-wide to low-income homeowners. The program is specific to owner-occupied, single-family dwellings. Grants and loans are available through the program depending on the type of repair, project cost and source of funding that is applicable.
Alpena County is an Equal Opportunity Lender, Provider, and Employer. Anyone who feels he or she has been discriminated against may file a complaint of housing discrimination:
